name: dsh-our-free-model
tagline: A plugin that gives you free access to AI models like DeepSeek and Kimi - no API key, no sign-up, no bill.
sentence: Install this plugin into DeepSeek Harness (a coding tool) and it routes your prompts through free model gateways, so you can use frontier AI models without paying for API credits.

board.say: Using AI models through their official channels costs money - API fees add up, and free tiers run out.
You install the plugin into DeepSeek Harness (a coding tool, like an AI-powered editor) and restart it.
Your prompts - the same questions and tasks you'd normally send to a paid AI model.
It connects to free model gateways and routes your prompts through them.
steps: Checks which free model providers are available from your network
Routes your prompt to the best available free gateway (OpenCode's Zen gateway, Kilo AI's public pool, or others)
If one provider is overloaded, falls back to the next one in a chain

board.say: AI model responses without an API bill.

outputs.eg: Prompts routed through free gateways to models like DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and Kimi K3
A local connection point so other tools on your computer can use the free models too

before: Using AI models costs money - credits, subscriptions, or pay-per-message fees that add up with heavy use
Free tiers from providers have strict limits and require sign-ups with email verification
Switching between free providers means managing multiple accounts and API keys
after: Send prompts to frontier models without paying - the plugin handles provider routing and fallbacks
No sign-up needed for the basic free lane (some premium channels require a GitHub login)
A local connection point lets other tools on your machine use the same free models
uses_note: This plugin has 52K stars but zero independent coverage or documented real-world uses by named individuals. The star-to-watcher ratio is unusual (40 watchers on 52K stars). Real adoption is unverified.

steps: Make sure you have [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/nicepkg/dsh) installed (the coding tool this plugin extends)
Clone this repo and run `dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-our-free-model`, then restart DeepSeek Harness
Send a prompt - the plugin routes it to a free model automatically. Check the status bar to see which provider answered.
try.paste:
/skillspector https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model
Then: Clone the repo, install it as a dsh plugin, restart dsh, and test with a prompt.

footprint.runs_on: Requires DeepSeek Harness and Node.js 22.19+ or 24+. Works on Mac, Windows and Linux wherever dsh runs.

best_for: DeepSeek Harness users who want to try AI models without paying for API credits
Hobbyists experimenting with different AI models on personal projects
skip_if: You need reliable, guaranteed uptime - free gateways can throttle or disappear
You send sensitive data - the README warns that free providers may log prompts
You don't use DeepSeek Harness (this is a plugin for that specific tool)

alternatives.name: OpenRouter free models
alternatives.line: A model router with some free-tier models, works with any tool that speaks the OpenAI format

watch: **Suspicious star growth.** The repo has 52K stars but only 40 watchers - a ratio that is far outside the normal range. The stars may not reflect real adoption.
**Free providers may log your prompts.** The README says Kilo's free pool 'may log prompts and use them to improve services.' Don't send passwords, API keys, personal data or confidential material.
**Free quotas can vanish.** The upstream providers set the free limits and can change, throttle or remove them at any time. The plugin has no control over this.
**Don't install from npm.** The README warns that a package named `dsh-our-free-model` on npm is a third-party copy and differs from this repo.
